scope: Source-traceable generic geometric feature declarations. Independent lifecycle; not a member of CadConstructionPlan v1 assertion/constraint unions; no public HTTP schema change. A failed feature contract never blocks or releases a candidate.

source_class_name_mapping.note: Round-5 draft names are renamed to the round-6 formal names; classes never upgrade between each other.

explicit.meaning: User-stated requirement; may participate in mandatory acceptance and may carry H3 user source authorization.

derived_semantic.meaning: Produced by a versioned, authorized semantic rule; independent semantic acceptance only. Cannot impersonate explicit and cannot replace H3 user source authorization.

model_assumption.meaning: Non-authoritative assumption; advisory only; never enters mandatory acceptance.

feature_id.constraints: min_length 1, unique within the contract set

source_refs.rule: Every ref must resolve to a valid entry in the current immutable requirement source index; the model cannot create, rename, or upgrade sources.

source_ref.rule: must match an entry in the source index

end.rule: exclusive offset; slice original_text[start:end] must equal evidence text

rule_id.rule: must be present in the authorized derivation rule registry

rule_version.rule: must match an authorized version for the rule_id

inference_steps.rule: explicit step from source wording to the declared feature

conclusion.rule: shadow conclusion used only for explicit/derived conflict detection; not a candidate decision

valid.rule: false when any validation error is attached

target_ref.rule: single target; one contract cannot bind multiple targets without a unique source correspondence

reference_ref.rule: second target for pair-scope features such as continuity

metrics.rule: measurement-specific quantities; no model-supplied threshold or expected value

tolerance_ref.rule: references an existing tolerance family; no new threshold is invented here

feature_measurement.measurement_note: Geometry measurement is implemented by the B-line hybrid mechanism: bidirectional nearest-point distance plus direction/endpoint/closure/part correspondence/topology. Hausdorff alone must not decide equivalence. When reliable error evidence cannot be produced, status is undetermined.

reused_tolerance_families.source: existing center_distance default 0.001 in the constraint solver
existing tangent_tolerance_deg and parallel/perpendicular angle tolerances

error_codes.guard: source ref absent from the valid source index; fail-closed
slice text differs from the recorded evidence text
source_revision differs from the current contract revision
rule/version absent from the authorized registry
one contract bound to multiple targets without unique source correspondence
explicit and derived conclusions contradict; explicit wins, derived downgraded to advisory, neither silently overwritten

reused_backend_functions.role: produces facts, sources and evidence spans; this module does not recompute them
produces the immutable request-scoped source index that source_refs resolve against
